svg.title: ZFP36L2 construct 151-220: zinc fingers, motifs and variant sites
svg.desc: Figure A1 of the ZFP36L2_AF3 write-up. Hand-editable: residues, motifs, Zn coordination and variant sites are separate named groups.

g.text: The construct: 70 residues, two CCCH zinc fingers
ZFP36L2 residues 151–220 (NP_008818.3), submitted to AlphaFold 3 with the ARE 5′-UUAUUUAUU-3′ and two Zn2+. Every variant is a single substitution in this window.
† Names follow Akçeşme et al. 2025. In this construct numbering the AF3 jobs mutate C212 (a finger-2 zinc ligand, used as the knockout control) and D219 (the C-terminal tail).
